evidence.observation: Pressure 3.00 Torr at start of growth, matching the ramp baseline
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.21 Torr (3.07, 3.14, 3.21) while argon holds at about 100 sccm
Exhaust O2 has risen from about 6-8 ppm during the ramp to 24.3 ppm, climbing at each step
Ar flow at 99.9 sccm, on setpoint, so the MFC is not overfeeding

args.missing_evidence: No reference values were given for this stage. A leak-rate test (isolate the tube and watch the pressure rise) would confirm the leak. A blocked exhaust should not raise O2, so the O2 rise argues against that. If O2 keeps rising, the leak is getting worse.
